response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans over the rolling hills and lush forests of the medieval kingdom, but something is off. The once-majestic stone walls now seem dull and grey, the flags bearing the royal crest now fluttering in the wind with a faint, eerie glow.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King ARIN, a stout and proud ruler in his mid-40s, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors and courtiers. But as he gazes out the window, his expression changes from regal to bewildered.

KING ARIN
(to his advisor, LORD THORNE)
What sorcery is this? The colors of our banners, once so bold and vibrant, now seem... faded.

LORD THORNE
(nervously)
Your Majesty, it's just the effects of the new dye we've been using. It's a special blend, one that will make our flags stand out even more.

KING ARIN
(skeptical)
I see. And what of the tapestries? They once told the stories of our great deeds, but now they seem... distorted.

LORD THORNE
(hesitantly)
Perhaps, Your Majesty, it's just a matter of perspective. The weavers have been experimenting with new techniques...

KING ARIN
(interrupting)
No, no, I think I see. It's not just the colors, it's the... atmosphere. The mood. The...

Suddenly, the room is filled with a strange, pulsating hum. The advisors and courtiers exchange nervous glances.

KING ARIN
(excitedly)
I know what it is! It's the... the... (he searches for the right words)...the "fog" of the future!

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans out to reveal the entire kingdom, now shrouded in a thick, misty haze. The flags still flutter, but they seem to be... rippling, like the surface of a pond.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Arin rises from his throne, a look of determination on his face.

KING ARIN
(to his advisors)
We will not be bound by the conventions of the past! We will... we will... (he searches for the right words)...we will "glitch" the status quo!

The advisors and courtiers look on in confusion as King Arin begins to make sweeping changes to the kingdom's aesthetic. The colors become more muted, the patterns more distorted. The tapestries now depict strange, surreal landscapes.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The kingdom is now a surreal, dreamlike landscape. The flags still flutter, but they seem to be... melting, like wax in a furnace. The misty haze has given way to a thick, foggy atmosphere.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Arin sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors and courtiers. But now, they all seem... different. Their faces are distorted, their eyes glowing with an otherworldly energy.

KING ARIN
(to his advisors)
We are the... the... (he searches for the right words)...the "vapor" kings!

The advisors and courtiers nod in agreement, their faces still distorted, but their eyes gleaming with a newfound sense of purpose.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
